oracleRisk.summary: cUSDO is the non-rebasing ERC-4626 wrapper of rebasing USDO, not a separately valued fund share. OpenEden's integration guide values cUSDO through convertToAssets, and its cUSDO documentation states that USDO and cUSDO accrue the same interest. Ethereum cUSDO proxy 0xad55aebc9b8c03fc43cd9f62260391c13c23e7c0 identifies verified implementation 0xb9413a34f68072a362b6a58f46c6af36c4e5d890, which initializes ERC4626 with USDO and inherits the asset-balance share conversion without an independent price oracle. The underlying USDO implementation lets DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE reset bonusMultiplier and MULTIPLIER_ROLE increase it without consulting an external NAV or reserve feed. Thus cUSDO's published conversion rate transmits privileged issuer-set USDO pricing rather than removing it. Chainlink's Base USDO Reserves feed is cross-chain Proof of Reserve over issuer-self-attested wallet addresses, not an independent cUSDO NAV setter. ChainSecurity's March 3, 2025 code assessment corroborates the multiplier and wrapper design; it is not a financial reserve attestation.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: cUSDO resolves Yes on a direct holder restriction. The 2026-10-19 census has no chain split, so supply was measured at pinned blocks: Ethereum 93.0688%, Solana 5.5567%, BSC 1.1422%, Base 0.2322% and Klaytn negligible. At Ethereum block 26224779 (2026-10-19T06:17:59Z), cUSDO 0xad55aebc9b8c03fc43cd9f62260391c13c23e7c0 is an ERC1967Proxy over verified cUSDO 0xb9413a34f68072a362b6a58f46c6af36c4e5d890, with USDO()=0x8238884ec9668ef77b90c6dff4d1a9f4f4823bfe. The implementation's _beforeTokenTransfer reverts cUSDOBlockedSender(from) when USDO.isBanned(from) is true and reverts when either token is paused; PAUSE_ROLE is held by 0x5eaff7af80488033bc845709806d5fae5291eb88 (hasRole=true), and paused()=false. The underlying USDO BANLIST_ROLE has two current members, so the issuer can stop a named holder's cUSDO transfers. The sub-threshold Solana mint BnANu5CtUogLqcvBNByJuwaRvRxNtVuDcAytwjsUUtqs separately carries freezeAuthority FPyi9yJKNX8y5gkadeFvbC2pDB9VVqxpwfofHxJ6Ed7i.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: cUSDO has a native Ethereum wrapper and native Solana Token-2022 route, while Base, BSC, and Kaia are peripheral representations built on Chainlink CCIP USDO underneath plus OpenEden cUSDO ERC-4626 wrappers. cUSDO itself has no token-level CCIP pool: inherited USDO bridge controls are scored here. The external-validated-network tier is inherited from USDO's Chainlink CCIP route.

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The pool reports typeAndVersion() = USDO BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1, owner() = 0x5eaff7af80488033bc845709806d5fae5291eb88, and router 0x881e3a65b4d4a04dd529061dd0071cf975f58bcd; the owner administers this bridge pool while Chainlink CCIP validation remains an external route dependency.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: The inherited USDO CCIP burn/mint path is constrained by CCIP message and source-pool accounting; local cUSDO shares are then minted only against Base USDO in the ERC-4626 wrapper. This is not independent native cUSDO issuance.
